findings.reason: The security group defines an ingress rule that allows TCP port 22 from the CIDR block 0.0.0.0/0, exposing SSH to the public internet.
findings.evidence: dynamic "ingress" { for_each = local.ingress_cidrs ... from_port = 22 to_port = 22 protocol = "tcp" cidr_blocks = [ingress.value] } where local.ingress_cidrs = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
